about_short_description.short_description: Clicks is an AI platform that automates back-office tasks like CRM updates, report generation, and data entry for businesses.

product.name: Clicks AI Agents Platform
product.description: AI agents that automate repetitive enterprise back-office tasks inside existing software, including data entry, document processing, reconciliation, status updates, and workflow follow-up.

product.name: Clicks Health
product.description: AI agents for healthcare operations that automate revenue cycle management and other back-office workflows across EHRs, practice-management systems, payer portals, and internal tools.

product.name: Clicks for Insurance
product.description: AI agents for insurance back-office operations, including claims intake, policy servicing, premium billing, reconciliation, and routine document and system updates.

product.name: Clicks for Mortgage & Lending
product.description: AI agents that automate mortgage and loan operations such as document intake, LOS data entry, condition tracking, compliance data collection, post-close quality control, and trailing-document management.

product.name: Workflow Automation Pilots and Implementation
product.description: A Clicks service that maps a customer’s manual workflow, evaluates automation potential, configures an AI agent, and deploys it within the customer’s existing systems.
